headline: Dream 92, Liberty 82: Atlanta leads the semifinal 1-0
whyCareReason: Jordin Canada scored 25. The Liberty led by 3 at half and lost the third quarter 32-15. Game 2 is not final.
teaser: Sunday 4 October, Atlanta. Canada 25, Bonner 23. Ionescu 27, Stewart 19. Series 1-0.
story: ESPN game 401918295: quarters Liberty 24-16-15-27, Dream 21-16-32-23. Jordin Canada scored 25, with 20 in the second half, and had 5 steals. DeWanna Bonner scored 23. AJC: Angel Reese 17 points and 7 rebounds, Rhyne Howard 16. Sabrina Ionescu scored 27 and Breanna Stewart 19. Allisha Gray left in the second quarter with a left-hand injury. Game 2 is Wednesday in Atlanta and is not a result here.
stakes: Best of five. Dream lead 1-0. Game 2 is not final.
rivalryAngle: An 8-seed that had swept the Lynx took Game 1 in Atlanta.
